text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Spring Fan Appreciation 
Festival. It's a day when fans who always 
cheer them on are invited to the academy, 
where the Umamusume put on various events.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Compared to the Autumn Hoof Festival, the 
spring edition is famous for featuring 
many athletic competitions, but the event 
Admire Vega is participating in this time 
is—"

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Committee Member A
text_block_list.text:
The “Inter-Generational Grand Tug-of-War” 
will be starting shortly on the athletic 
field!!

text_block_list.name: Thanksgiving Committee Member B
text_block_list.text:
The viewing seats are filling up, so if 
you'd like to watch, please head over as 
soon as possible~~!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Aaaand it's finally time to begin!! The 
"Generational Tug-of-War" Clash--!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
All you fans gathered here today!! Let's 
hear your cheers! Your applause! Give me 
all your wildest, craziest passioooon, 
pleeeaaase!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaaaaahhhhh!!)

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"...E~l~, are you satisfied yet~? We're 
participants, so let's give the microphone 
back to the commentators, okay?"

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Eeeh! Working the mic is important, you 
know! We gotta hype things up from here 
on—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes! Just kidding, it was a joke-joke! 
I'll be right there-dees!!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah, you're finally back!! Jeez, 
ditching our strategy meeting like that."

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, no need to make such a fuss. 
We're pretty much in sync already, so we 
don't really need a strategy meeting, do 
we~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Even in the meetings leading up to the 
main event, we pretty much only talked 
about the team name anyway.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
What was it again, King's 
'Super☆First-Class Five' and El's 
'Soul☆Amiga Clan' got into a massive fight 
and~...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
In the end, we drew lots, and my "Go for 
It, Sparkling Troupe" won!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
"Sei-chan, King-chan, El-chan, Grass-chan! 
—Let's win this!!"

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! The 'Golden Generation' that's 
been rocking the Twinkle Series is all 
gathered together...! This is hype, so 
freakin' hype~!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I saw on Umatter that you two were totally 
in sync during practice! Sounds super 
strong~

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text: So, um, the opposing team is—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaha!! Alea iacta est!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now, Team 'Overlord Quintet'! Are you 
fully prepared to march into battle?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Opera O-chan, Doto-chan, Urara-chan, 
Ayabe-san! —Let's defeat the Golden 
Generation together!

text_block_list.name: Dotou & Urara
text_block_list.text: Ooh!! Oooh...!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Leave it to me! I've been practicing 
pulling tons! Ehehe, though it hurt when 
someone pulled on my tail!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
First, don't fall, and even if I fall, 
don't let go...! At the very least, I can 
be a paperweight...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
It's starting. ...Let's go take care of 
the setup.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
O-Ohh...? The opposing team sure has big 
personalities, but they feel completely 
out of sync, don't they?

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Now, now, we won't know till we see it. 
Look, it's starting!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
The Generation Tug-of-War Battle has 
finally begun!! First up is the 
star-studded matchup: "Fight on! Glitter 
Troop" vs. "The Overlord Quintet"!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
It's a best-of-three match format—first to 
two wins takes the victory!! Now 
then—Match 1, START!!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Here we go, everyone!! Ready, set... 
heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Hang-in-There Glitter Gang
text_block_list.text: Heave-hooo!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, awesome!! The Golden Generation 
really are totally in sync!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Nunu! Hmph... Hnnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Overlords Quintet
text_block_list.text: Waaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Oh! The Haou's Quintet crumbles completely 
here! The victory in match one goes to the 
Keppare Glitter Gang!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even T.M. Opera O clenched her teeth and 
held on for dear life, but... she narrowly 
conceded the victory!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Uhyaa! I lost!! Spe-chan and the others 
are so strong!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Uuugh, their teamwork is just so perfectly 
in sync... Every time they chant, the rope 
gets so, so heavy...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
We did decide on a battle cry and 
practiced it, but... we got beaten before 
we even had the breathing room to shout 
it, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if only we could get our coordination 
down a little better...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...There's no point in trying to imitate 
your opponent.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Unlike over there, we're all in different 
grades, and we don't necessarily hang out 
together all the time.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"When it comes to 'being in sync,' I think 
it'd be pretty tough to beat the Golden 
Generation."

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Ugh...! Th-That's certainly true...

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...Still, we have our own way of fighting, 
don't we?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: —Opera O.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Hm! ...What is it, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"Considering who your opponent was, maybe 
you felt you had to psych yourself up in 
your own way, though I'm not really sure."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Putting on airs of being the Supreme 
Overlord even in your team name, yet 
refusing to "drag us into it"... That's 
entirely too unfair, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
You're the one who starts these operas out 
of nowhere. You're the one who connects us 
on your own whims and drags us onto the 
same stage.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
...It's always been that way, hasn't it? 
In that case, hurry up and start playing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And now, Match 2—!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Oh, dost thou stand in my way, golden 
wave?! Surging, churning, crashing down!! 
Dost thou intend to block the path to 
victory! (La la~♪)

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hah...!! La, la-la-la~!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
However, I will not lose, I will not 
falter!! Aaah, and why is that~? (Why is 
that—?!)

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, and the reason issss...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Yes! I will!! We will!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: T-The C-o-n-q-u-e-r-i-n-g Q-u-i-n-t-e-t♪!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Tee-toot...♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Grrr-grrr-grind!!)

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what's with that chant... 
S-Singing?! How in the world does that 
make you stronger, yes?!!

text_block_list.name: Commentator Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
An unthinkable, miraculous vic-to-ry for 
the Overlord's Quintet! A total 180 from 
Match 1, showing off... um... s-some truly 
unique teamwork!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOOOO!?)

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Huh, that was seriously unique, wasn't 
it!? What was that anyway... a song!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the outcome of the match, now 
completely unpredictable, was—!!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Too bad, we lost—! Aw man, I really 
wanted us all to win together."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...That was close, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, we conceded victory in the 
third match, suffering a narrow defeat and 
elimination.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Still—I think it was a good day, one where 
we got to see Admire Vega's own brand of 
love for her generation.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"I wanna sing with Ayabe-san again! 
Ayabe-san's singing voice is soooo 
pretty!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...You heard that?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahahaha!! Grand☆Victory!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
O, disciple of our stars, who did whisper 
words of wisdom! Accept now my embrace of 
gratitude—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Save that kind of talk, will you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! But honestly, aren't you and Opera 
O-chan actually in pretty good sync, 
Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
No, I've actually been thinking that for 
quite a while now!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
You know how Ayabe-san's words often sound 
like something out of a storybook... or 
kind of romantic at times, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, is the way I choose my words—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...No, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
"...Ayabe-san? Um, I'm going to turn off 
the lights now, okay~?"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Hey, am I—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text: Pardon?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...I'm sorry, it's nothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—In any case, it turned out to be a 
wonderful Fan Appreciation Day!
